lean.statement:
theorem finiteRingUnit_isIso {U : Scheme.{t}} (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso (whiskerRight (ringUnit d U) (d.reduction U n))

title: Invertibility of the finite reduction of the completed ring unit
statement: For the completed coefficient datum on every scheme U, the reduction of the completed ring unit is an isomorphism: whiskerRight (ringUnit d U) (d.reduction U n) is invertible for every n : ℕ.

proof.text: First prove that exact conservative functors between abelian categories induce conservative derived functors: apply the homology comparison isomorphism, reflect each homology isomorphism, and use DerivedCategory.isIso_iff. The second equation of rho_unit transports ringUnit across ringCompletionRestriction to the constant-coefficient unit. The second conjunct of strictUnits at the identity immersion makes its constant reduction invertible. Cancel the completion-restriction isomorphism, transport through rho, and reflect through exchangeTowerRes, whose underlying scalar restriction is exact and conservative. Thus completedReductionTower maps every component of ringUnit to an isomorphism. Apply derived evaluation at n, use completedReductionEvaluation, and reflect through exact scalar restriction along the quotient projection. Componentwise invertibility proves the stated natural transformation is invertible.
